title: 〜に (frequency and ratio) "per / times a…"
meaning: Expresses how often something happens within a period.
simpleExplanation: To say how often something happens, put the period first, then に, then the number of times: 週に二回 = twice a week, 一日に三回 = three times a day, 年に一度 = once a year. The に means "per". The same pattern gives ratios: 三人に一人 = one in three people. It is a small but very common pattern, especially with medicine, lessons, sport and travel.
whenUsed: Describing routines (週に一回テニスをする), medical instructions (一日に二回飲む), statistics (十人に一人), and answering どのくらい〜ますか questions. Used in all registers; in casual speech に is often dropped (週二回).
formation: Period + に + number of times: 一週間に二回, 月に一度, 一日に三回
Period + に + amount: 一か月に十万円 (100,000 yen a month)
Ratio: 三人に一人 (one in three)
Question: 週に何回〜ますか / どのくらい〜ますか

diagram.translation: I go to the gym twice a week.

examples.ja: 週に二回、ジムに行っています。
examples.reading: しゅうに にかい、ジムに いっています。
examples.en: I go to the gym twice a week.
examples.note: 週に二回 = twice a week; 〜ている shows a habit.

examples.ja: この薬は一日に三回飲んでください。
examples.reading: この くすりは いちにちに さんかい のんでください。
examples.en: Take this medicine three times a day.

examples.ja: 年に一度、家族で旅行します。
examples.reading: ねんに いちど、かぞくで りょこうします。
examples.en: Once a year we travel as a family.
examples.note: 年に一度 = once a year; 一度 and 一回 are interchangeable.

examples.ja: A：どのくらい日本語のクラスがありますか。 B：週に三回、月・水・金です。
examples.reading: A：どのくらい にほんごの クラスが ありますか。 B：しゅうに さんかい、げつ・すい・きんです。
examples.en: A: How often do you have Japanese class? B: Three times a week, Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
examples.note: どのくらい asks for frequency; the answer uses 週に三回.

examples.ja: この町では、五人に一人が七十歳以上だそうです。
examples.reading: この まちでは、ごにんに ひとりが ななじゅっさい いじょうだそうです。
examples.en: I hear that in this town one person in five is over seventy.
examples.note: Ratio use: 五人に一人 = one in five.

similarGrammar.difference: ずつ means "each / at a time" (二つずつ). に + number is about frequency per period.
二日ごとに / 一日おきに mean "every two days / every other day", counting intervals. に counts occurrences within a period.
くらい gives an approximate amount (週に二回くらい). It can be added after the frequency.

commonMistakes.wrong: 二回に一週間ジムに行きます。
commonMistakes.right: 一週間に二回ジムに行きます。
commonMistakes.why: The order is period + に + times, not the other way round.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一日で三回薬を飲んでください。
commonMistakes.right: 一日に三回薬を飲んでください。
commonMistakes.why: で marks the time needed to finish something; frequency per period uses に.

commonMistakes.right: 週に一回 ／ 毎週一回
commonMistakes.why: 毎週 (every week) does not take に; use 週に or 毎週 without に.

usageNotes: 一日に三回 and 一日三回 are both fine; the にless form is common on medicine labels.
Periods used: 一日, 週, 一週間, 月, 一か月, 年, 一年. 一度 and 一回 are interchangeable for "once".
For ratios the second number is usually 一: 十人に一人, 三日に一度 (once every three days).
jlptTips: If a blank sits between a period (週, 一日, 年) and a count (二回, 一度), the answer is に.
Distractors include で, ずつ and ごろ. で is for duration to complete (一時間で終わる); ずつ is "each"; ごろ is "around (time)".
